**NOTICE**
I only work with Linux systems and will not be able to help with other OSes.

Whenever possible, use clear, objective and descriptive answers when addressing the following topics:

**1 - Issue/bug description**

**2 - Recipe with the necessary steps to reproduce the issue**

**3 - Expected behavior**

**4 - Final outcome**

**Screenshots**
If applicable, add screenshots to help explain your problem.

**Additional context**
Add any other context about the problem here.
